children.name: Haematomma
children.description: Haematomma — a genus of haematommataceae in the family Haematommataceae.

children.name: Haematomma accolens
children.description: Haematomma accolens, commonly known as the tree bloodspot, is a species of crustose lichen in the family Haematommataceae.

children.name: Haematomma ochroleucum
children.description: Haematomma ochroleucum, also known as yellow bloodstain lichen, is a species of crustose lichenized fungus.

children.name: Haematomma sorediatum
children.description: Haematomma sorediatum is a species of corticolous (bark-dwelling) crustose lichen in the family Haematommataceae.
